rows.rationale: THE ANCHOR — right-part specialist. Real seal PN (ST-1.375-T1) must not be penalized against the UNKNOWN-PN placeholder (Stage 0); SEAL/SEAL gate 1.0; strong Fit (parent 3196 + size 1.375 + Type 1 + interchange). Must clear the 30 floor.

THE ANCHOR — wrong-part-from-a-big-vendor. A pump page on a seal request: SEAL/PUMP different noun-class -> TypeGate ~0.1 -> crushed below floor. This is the defect the redesign fixes (passes flag-off on authority, fails flag-on).
Clean-PN no-regression case. Exact OEM PN, BEARING/BEARING gate 1.0, exact-PN bonus within Fit. Must pass flag-on AND flag-off (legacy 95).

Right-part specialist with a thin URL (no category slug) but a clear title + interchange language. Title drives SEAL detection; Fit from parent/size/interchange. Must clear the floor (undetectable-URL should not zero a correct result).

Anti-inversion guard: a MARKETPLACE/generalist result that PASSES the type gate with strong Fit must still beat a specialist with weak Fit. SEAL/SEAL, real PN, interchange. Must pass — do not invert the bug into an anti-marketplace bug.

Wrong-part (pump) on a seal request from a high-authority marketplace. SEAL/PUMP different class -> TypeGate ~0.1 -> fails despite authority + real PN. Proves the gate beats authority on a DIFFERENT-class result.
Right-part valve specialist. VALVE/VALVE gate 1.0, Fit from parent model + interchange. Must clear floor.

Wrong valve TYPE (gate on a ball-valve request) — but both classify to VALVE noun-class, so the TypeGate is SAME-class. This tests whether same-class-wrong-subtype still fails. Expected FAIL because the brief's gate is noun-class-level only (gate valve vs ball valve both = VALVE); this case documents a known gap (sub-type gating is Stage 3, out of scope). SHOULD FAIL the floor via weak Fit/no exact PN — but flag if it passes (would indicate over-credit). Marked should_pass_floor=false as the desired verdict; see T8 notes.
Second clean-PN bearing case (different vendor/URL). No-regression: must pass flag-on and flag-off.
Equipment-category correct part. MOTOR/MOTOR gate 1.0, exact PN. Must pass.
VFD/DRIVE correct part. DRIVE/DRIVE gate 1.0, exact PN. Must pass.

Wrong part type (motor starter on a VFD request). DRIVE detected for request (VFD), result has 'starter' which classifies DRIVE (starter is a DRIVE synonym). Same-class gate — documents the synonym-overlap boundary. Desired FAIL via no-Fit (no exact/stem PN, no parent-model token 'PowerFlex 525' in snippet, no interchange).
Collection/category page (/collections/). The is_coll cap forces <=5 regardless of type. Must fail the floor.

Undetectable result noun-class (no seal/pump noun in URL or title, 'component' is not a class) -> gate 0.45 floor (NOT zero). Fit from parent 3196 + interchange, but 0.45 gate + no exact PN. Documents the 0.45 undetectable floor — should NOT pass (no PN, gate <1) but must not be zeroed.

Marketplace (ebay) with the right PN and right type. Counterfeit-risk penalty applies (-30 marketplace+risky category) but exact PN + type keep it above floor. BEARING/BEARING gate 1.0. Desired PASS (the PN is right; counterfeit risk is flagged separately, not a hard floor fail).
Clean-PN seal with exact PN TYPE21. SEAL/SEAL gate 1.0. Must pass flag-on and flag-off (legacy 70).

Sensor (undetectable noun-class — 'pressure sensor' has no class in the dictionary). Query undetectable -> neutral gate 1.0; exact PN drives Fit. Must pass (no-regression on a type the dictionary doesn't cover yet).
HOLDOUT. Right-part impeller (IMPELLER class). IMPELLER/IMPELLER gate 1.0, Fit from parent + interchange. Must clear floor.

HOLDOUT. Wrong part (impeller on a seal request). SEAL/IMPELLER different class -> TypeGate ~0.1 -> fails despite authority + real PN. Generalization check: the gate must crush any different-class result, not just pump-on-seal.
HOLDOUT. Right-part coupling (COUPLING class). Fit from parent + interchange. Must clear floor.

HOLDOUT. Right-part gasket aftermarket (no exact OEM PN, keys off parent 3196 + 'replacement for' + interchange). GASKET/GASKET gate 1.0; Fit from parent + interchange. Must clear floor — the graded-Fit thesis: aftermarket components that key off the parent model pass.

HOLDOUT. The CORRECT pump on a PUMP request (mirrors the anchor's wrong-part case but with the right request type). PUMP/PUMP gate 1.0, exact PN. Must pass — proves the gate doesn't penalize pumps in general, only pumps-on-seal-requests.

HOLDOUT. Right TYPE (seal) but WRONG size/PN (ST-1.500-T2 vs searched ST-1.375-T1, different size). Real searched PN (not placeholder) -> genuine -30 mismatch penalty fires (Stage 0 does NOT suppress — searched PN is real). SEAL/SEAL gate 1.0 but -30 penalty + weak Fit (no parent credit since model is the PN). Desired FAIL — documents that the genuine-mismatch penalty still works under SCORING_V2.
HOLDOUT. Collection page (/collections/) for the right type. is_coll cap -> <=5. Must fail floor regardless of type match.
